relationships.subject: caspase-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Activated caspase-1 then processes pro-IL-1β and pro-IL-18 into their matured and activated forms, leading to the release of potent inflammatory cytokines.

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: inorganic crystals such as hydroxyapatite, calcium phosphate, and monosodium urate in the joint can act as DAMPs that primarily activate the NLRP3 inflammasome through TLR4-dependent pathways

relationships.subject: TGF-β
relationships.evidence_quote: Specifically, TGF-β is a central mediator for fibroblast-to-myofibroblast transition, tissue repair, and pathological fibrosis.

key_findings: Review: FLS-to-myofibroblast transition drives synovial fibrosis in OA via TGF-β/Smad, Wnt/β-catenin, YAP/TAZ, inflammatory and NLRP3 signaling.
